mutants.description: The release qualification time is written as a terminal count (RELEASE_CLKS-1), but the assert time is not, so only a release qualifies one clock early
mutants.reason: After flag_in goes low and stays low while flag_out is high, flag_out falls after RELEASE_CLKS-1 clocks instead of RELEASE_CLKS. The assert timing does not change.

mutants.description: The disagreement counter only counts the release direction (flag_in low while flag_out is high), the move away from the high reset state, so an assert attempt never builds a count
mutants.reason: Once flag_out has released, flag_in going high and staying high leaves the counter at 0. The flip compare against ASSERT_CLKS-1 never passes, so flag_out never re-asserts.

mutants.description: The disagreement counter is preloaded to a full count in reset, so the first input level seen after reset is accepted without debouncing
mutants.reason: With flag_in low when rst_n is released, flag_out (reset high) falls on the first clock instead of after RELEASE_CLKS clocks of stable low. A glitch at that moment is passed straight through.
